**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**

At **Blue Dart**, we go beyond delivering shipments—we deliver trust, precision, and excellence. As India’s most reliable express logistics provider, we empower commerce by reaching over 56,000+ locations across India and connecting to 220+ countries through our global DHL network. Backed by the strength of DHL Group, we bring together international standards with deep local expertise. Our dedicated Boeing freighter fleet, 12,000+ vehicles, and best-in-class service ensure time-definite delivery that businesses and customers count on every day.

We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work®** and recognized as part of the DHL Group’s Top Employer certification across multiple regions. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal—it’s a fundamental part of who we are. We are committed to creating a workplace where people feel valued, empowered, and proud to belong.

If you're looking to join a purpose-led, people-first organization that shapes India’s supply chain with integrity and care—**Blue Dart is where you belong**.

**Position Overview:**

The Air Hub Manager is accountable for end-to-end operational performance of an individual Air Hub, ensuring safe, timely and accurate movement of inbound, outbound and transit shipments in synchronization with flight schedules and downstream network cut-offs.

The role owns day-to-day Air Hub execution including shipment receipt, processing, build-up / breakdown, loading and unloading, operational cut-off adherence, manpower deployment, throughput, turnaround time, shipment quality and coordination with Aviation and ground-handling stakeholders.

Leads hub operational teams across shifts and ensures seamless connectivity between Aviation, First Mile, CPU, Surface and Last Mile operations.

The role works closely with the Regional Air Hub Manager and Regional Air Fleet & Network Manager to ensure flight connectivity, vehicle placement, capacity utilization, disruption recovery and consistent service performance.

**Job Purpose:**

To manage a safe, reliable and high-performing Air Hub by ensuring timely shipment processing and flight connectivity, optimum manpower and infrastructure utilization, strict adherence to operational cut-offs, and continuous improvement in throughput, service quality, productivity and cost.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Air Hub Operational Leadership**

* Own day-to-day operational performance of the Air Hub across all shifts.
* Translate flight schedules, shipment volumes and regional network requirements into daily operating plans.
* Ensure timely receipt, processing, build-up / breakdown and dispatch of inbound, outbound and transit shipments.
* Maintain operational readiness for all scheduled and ad-hoc flight movements.
* Ensure seamless handover between Air Hub, Aviation, Fleet, CPU, Surface and Last Mile operations.
* Proactively escalate network, capacity or service risks to the Regional Air Hub Manager.

**Flight & Network Connectivity**

* Ensure shipments are processed and positioned within defined flight and network cut-offs.
* Monitor inbound and outbound flight connectivity and prevent avoidable missed connections.
* Coordinate with Aviation and ground-handling teams on flight schedules, aircraft capacity and operational changes.
* Ensure rapid operational response to delays, cancellations, diversions or capacity constraints.
* Coordinate contingency plans and recovery actions during network disruptions.
* Ensure timely downstream connectivity following inbound flight arrivals.

**Hub Throughput & Turnaround Time**

* Own hub throughput, processing TAT and flight-related operational timelines.
* Monitor hourly shipment flow and identify potential bottlenecks before they affect connectivity.
* Ensure effective load balancing across shifts and operating areas.
* Drive rapid turnaround of inbound and outbound shipment flows.
* Prevent backlog accumulation and ensure timely clearance of shipment exceptions.
* Improve flow efficiency through process and layout optimization.

**People Leadership & Workforce Management**

* Lead supervisors, executives, operational employees and outsourced workforce across the Air Hub.
* Plan shift manpower based on flight schedules, shipment volumes and operational requirements.
* Ensure effective deployment across processing, build-up, breakdown, loading and support activities.
* Drive productivity, attendance, discipline and accountability across shifts.
* Build capability through coaching, structured training and on-the-job development.
* Maintain contingency manpower plans for absenteeism, peak periods and irregular operations.

**Shipment Quality & Operational Accuracy**

* Ensure accurate shipment processing, scanning, segregation and routing.
* Monitor missorts, misroutes, damages, offloads and other Air Hub exceptions.
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective action for recurring operational defects.
* Ensure physical-to-system shipment reconciliation and complete scan compliance.
* Maintain shipment security, handling quality and chain-of-custody discipline.
* Reduce rework and avoidable service failures.

**Capacity & Infrastructure Management**

* Monitor Air Hub processing and infrastructure capacity against current and forecast volumes.
* Ensure availability and operational readiness of equipment, workstations and material-handling systems.
* Coordinate with Engineering / Facilities teams for maintenance and breakdown resolution.
* Support layout optimization and infrastructure improvements.
* Identify emerging capacity constraints and provide inputs for expansion or enhancement.
* Ensure readiness for peak periods and major customer volume surges.

**Cost & Productivity Management**

* Monitor operating cost and productivity of the Air Hub.
* Drive improvement in shipments per man-hour and resource utilization.
* Optimize manpower deployment, consumables and facility resources.
* Reduce avoidable handling, overtime, rework and operational wastage.
* Track cost and productivity trends and initiate corrective actions where required.
* Support achievement of regional cost-efficiency objectives without compromising service.

**Safety, Security & Compliance**

* Ensure strict adherence to operational, aviation-interface, safety and security requirements.
* Maintain compliance with Blue Dart SOPs, applicable airport procedures and internal control requirements.
* Conduct regular operational and safety reviews.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations and corrective actions.
* Coordinate with Security and Aviation stakeholders on shipment-handling and access-control requirements.
* Maintain strong workplace safety, housekeeping and equipment-operating standards.

**Continuous Improvement & Technology**

* Identify recurring bottlenecks and operational failure points within the hub.
* Drive structured root-cause analysis and continuous-improvement initiatives.
* Support implementation of automation, scanning and digital-operating tools.
* Track adoption and benefits from new processes and technologies.
* Use operational data to identify productivity and service-improvement opportunities.
* Share successful practices with the Regional Air Hub Manager for wider replication.

**Stakeholder & Governance**

* Work closely with the Regional Air Hub Manager and Regional Air Fleet & Network Manager.
* Coordinate with Aviation, CPU, Surface Operations, First Mile, Last Mile, Security, Engineering, IT, Finance and HR.
* Conduct regular performance reviews with shift and operational teams.
* Provide accurate daily / weekly operational reporting and network-risk visibility.
* Ensure timely escalation and resolution of issues impacting flights or network connectivity.
* Act as the location SME for Air Hub operations.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* **Education**: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration or related discipline preferred; MBA / PG desirable.
* **Experience**: **8–11 years** of relevant experience in express logistics, air cargo, aviation-linked logistics, hub operations, transportation or high-throughput distribution operations.
* Strong hands-on exposure to Air Hub / airport logistics, hub processing, mid-mile or network operations.
* Experience managing inbound, outbound and transit shipment flows in a time-critical operating environment.
* Proven experience leading medium-to-large operational teams across multiple shifts.
* Strong understanding of operational cut-offs, shipment connectivity, throughput and turnaround-time management.
* Experience in manpower planning, productivity management and cost optimization.
* Exposure to flight coordination, airport operations or aviation-linked ground operations preferred.
* Experience in disruption management and operational contingency planning.
* Exposure to automation, scanning and material-handling technologies preferred.
* Preferred Industries: Express Logistics, Air Cargo, Aviation Logistics, Courier, 3PL, eCommerce Logistics, Transportation and Supply Chain Operations.

**Skills & Capabilities:**

* Air Hub Operations Management
* Air Cargo / Express Shipment Processing
* Flight & Network Connectivity Management
* Hub Throughput & TAT Management
* Operational Cut-off Management
* Shift & Manpower Planning
* Shipment Build-up / Breakdown Coordination

title: Production Manager - Cushions & Covers unit
description:
**Designation: Manager – Cushion & Covers**

**Location: Gandhinagar, Gujarat**

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Production Manager – Cushion & Cover Category to lead end-to-end production operations for our cushion, cover, soft furnishing, and related customized textile products.The incumbent will be responsible for managing production planning and execution, cutting, stitching/sewing, filling, finishing, quality, manpower productivity, machine utilization, and timely order fulfilment.The role requires strong expertise in soft textile products, cushion and cover manufacturing, stitching operations, production planning, process optimization, quality management, and large-scale shop-floor operations. The candidate will work closely with PPC, Quality, SCM, Industrial Engineering, Maintenance, Design, and other cross-functional teams to ensure efficient and timely execution of customer orders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Production Operations Management**

* Lead day-to-day production operations for cushion, covers, soft furnishings, and customized textile products.
* Manage end-to-end manufacturing processes including fabric cutting, printing/customization, stitching, sewing, filling, assembly, finishing, packing, and dispatch.
* Ensure achievement of daily, weekly, and monthly production targets.
* Optimize manpower and machine utilization to achieve planned production volumes.
* Ensure production schedules are executed as per customer requirements and committed delivery timelines.
* Monitor shop-floor operations and proactively address bottlenecks affecting production output.

**2. Production Planning & Execution**

* Coordinate closely with PPC and SCM teams to ensure availability of fabrics, trims, fillers, accessories, packaging materials, and other required raw materials.
* Plan production capacity based on order volumes, product complexity, manpower availability, and machine capacity.
* Monitor WIP, production flow, line balancing, machine loading, and bottlenecks.
* Ensure effective production sequencing for multiple SKUs, customized orders, and varying product specifications.
* Establish effective shift planning, production allocation, and handover mechanisms.
* Ensure smooth execution of urgent and priority orders without compromising quality.

**3. Cutting, Stitching & Sewing Operations**

* Drive operational efficiency across cutting, stitching, sewing, filling, assembly, and finishing processes.
* Optimize cutting layouts and fabric utilization to minimize wastage.
* Improve stitching productivity through appropriate machine allocation, line balancing, and operator skill mapping.
* Monitor sewing machine efficiency, operator productivity, cycle times, and line output.
* Identify process constraints and implement corrective actions to improve throughput.
* Standardize processes and SOPs across different product categories and production lines.

**4. Quality Management**

* Ensure adherence to defined product specifications, workmanship standards, and customer requirements.
* Minimize defects, rejection, rework, fabric wastage, stitching defects, dimensional deviations, and finishing issues.
* Work closely with QA/QC teams to establish process quality checkpoints.
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions for recurring quality issues.
* Ensure consistency in dimensions, stitching quality, filling density, finishing, appearance, and overall product quality.
* Monitor quality metrics and implement continuous improvement initiatives.

**5. Manpower & Shop-Floor Management**

* Lead supervisors, line leaders, operators, tailors, cutters, helpers, and other shop-floor personnel.
* Plan manpower deployment based on production requirements and skill availability.
* Monitor attendance, productivity, discipline, and workforce utilization.
* Develop skill matrices and identify training requirements for operators and supervisors.
* Drive multi-skilling and cross-training initiatives to improve workforce flexibility.
* Build a performance-oriented, disciplined, and safety-focused production culture.

**6. Machine & Equipment Management**

* Ensure optimum utilization of stitching, sewing, cutting, printing, filling, and finishing equipment.
* Coordinate with Maintenance teams to minimize machine breakdowns and production downtime.
* Monitor machine efficiency and support preventive maintenance initiatives.
* Identify requirements for new machines, tooling, automation, and process improvements.
* Support machine installation, trials, commissioning, and production stabilization.
* Evaluate opportunities for automation in repetitive and high-volume production processes.

**7. Productivity & Process Improvement**

* Drive Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, 5S, line balancing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Improve productivity through optimization of manpower, machine utilization, process flow, and cycle times.
* Identify opportunities to reduce material wastage, rework, overtime, and production costs.
* Analyze production MIS and KPI dashboards to identify performance gaps.
* Establish and monitor KPIs for productivity, efficiency, quality, wastage, downtime, and on-time production.
* Drive standardization and process improvement across the cushion and cover manufacturing operations.

**8. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Work closely with PPC, SCM, Quality, Industrial Engineering, Maintenance, Design, Product Development, and Warehouse teams.
* Coordinate with Design/Product teams to understand new product specifications and manufacturing requirements.
* Support new product introduction (NPI), sampling, trials, and production scale-up.
* Ensure smooth transition of new products from sampling to mass production.
* Resolve production-related issues impacting order fulfillment and customer commitments.

**9. Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to EHS and statutory requirements across the production floor.
* Maintain safe working practices across cutting, stitching, filling, printing, and finishing operations.
* Conduct regular shop-floor audits and ensure timely closure of safety observations.
* Promote 5S, workplace discipline, housekeeping, and safe equipment handling.

**Key Deliverables**

* Achievement of daily/monthly production targets.
* Improved production efficiency and machine utilization.
* Reduction in rejection, rework, wastage, and production losses.
* Improved stitching, cutting, filling, and finishing productivity.
* Improved fabric utilization and reduction in material wastage.
* Timely completion of customized customer orders.
* Effective manpower utilization and productivity improvement.
* Reduction in machine downtime and process bottlenecks.
* Successful execution of new product introductions and production scale-ups.
* Controlled manufacturing cost and continuous process improvement.
* Safe, disciplined, and compliant production operations.

**Qualification & Experience**

* Bachelor’s Degree/Diploma in Textile Engineering, Production, Mechanical, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 8–12 years of experience in textile, home furnishing, soft furnishing, cushion, cover, upholstery, garmenting, or related manufacturing operations.
* Strong experience in cutting, stitching/sewing, filling, finishing, and soft textile product manufacturing.
* Experience managing large shop-floor manpower and multiple production lines/shifts.
* Strong understanding of production planning, line balancing, productivity improvement, quality management, and manufacturing KPIs.
* Exposure to Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, 5S, and process improvement will be preferred.
* Experience in customized/high-SKU or e-commerce manufacturing environments will be an added advantage.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, people-management, and cross-functional coordination skills.

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹1,400,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

description:
**Key Responsibilities-**

* **Production Planning and Execution:** Plan manpower, materials, and daily production targets to achieve the required output of 100–500 units per month per assembly line, as applicable, while minimizing overtime and production delays.

* Achievement of daily and monthly production targets.
* Product quality, rejection, and rework rates.
* On-time production and delivery performance.

* Material wastage and inventory accuracy.
* Production downtime and line efficiency.
* Implementation of 5S, safety, and process improvements.

* Bachelor’s Degree or, Electrical Engineering, Production Engineering, or Manufacutring Industrial Engineering.

* Conduct daily shift briefings and communicate operational updates and safety requirements.
* Monitor workforce productivity, attendance and adherence to operational standards.
* Support capability building through coaching, training and performance feedback.

* Coordinate with fleet partners and transport vendors to minimise delays and maximise vehicle utilisation.
* Monitor dock utilisation, bay allocation and turnaround times to improve hub efficiency.
* Support capacity planning during peak volumes, network changes and seasonal demand fluctuations.
* Ensure operational readiness of manpower, equipment and infrastructure to meet business requirements.

**Service Quality & Operational Excellence**

* Drive adherence to network timelines and ensure timely connectivity of shipments across the air or surface network.
* Monitor shipment accuracy, scanning compliance, loading quality and dispatch integrity to minimise operational errors.
* Ensure timely closure of operational exceptions, stock lying at hub (SLAH), misroutes and misconnections.
* Review operational performance trends and implement corrective actions to improve service reliability.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance hub productivity, service quality and operational efficiency.

**Safety, Security & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with organisational policies, operational SOPs, aviation or transportation regulations and statutory requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring safe handling of shipments, vehicles and operational equipment.
* Support periodic operational, security and quality audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory documentation, shipment security requirements and operational controls applicable to the hub.
* Identify operational risks and implement preventive measures to ensure uninterrupted hub operations.

* Coordinate closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Operations, Customer Service, Security and Regional Operations teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Maintain effective communication with upstream and downstream network locations regarding shipment movements, operational disruptions and recovery plans.
* Ensure timely escalation of operational risks, capacity constraints and service issues to the Head – Hub Operations.
* Build collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and transport partners to improve network performance.
* Support implementation of organisational initiatives, process changes and operational improvement programmes across the hub.

**People Leadership & Capability Development**

* Lead, coach and develop supervisors, operational employees and outsourced workforce to achieve operational objectives.
* Conduct regular shift briefings and ensure effective communication of operational priorities, safety requirements and service expectations.
* Monitor employee productivity, attendance, discipline and overall team performance.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Hub Operations is responsible for managing end\-to\-end mid\-mile operations at an assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring seamless movement of shipments across the Blue Dart network. The role oversees inbound, outbound and transit operations, enabling timely network connectivity, operational accuracy and service reliability while maintaining the highest standards of safety, compliance and productivity.


Reporting to the Head – Hub Operations, the incumbent leads shift operations across the hub by coordinating shipment processing, fleet movements, manpower deployment and operational resources. The role works closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Customer Service and Regional Operations teams to ensure network schedules are met, operational exceptions are proactively managed, and hub performance supports Blue Dart's service commitments.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To manage mid\-mile hub operations by ensuring timely movement of shipments across the network, maximising hub productivity, maintaining network connectivity, driving operational excellence and ensuring compliance with organisational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Hub Operations Management**

* Lead day\-to\-day operations across the assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring efficient inbound, outbound and transit shipment movement.
* Ensure adherence to network schedules, operational workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Plan daily hub activities based on shipment volumes, network priorities and operational requirements.
* Ensure optimum utilisation of hub infrastructure, operational resources and manpower.
* Support the Head – Hub Operations in achieving operational, service quality and productivity objectives.

**Mid Mile Network Operations**

* Ensure timely receipt, processing, consolidation and dispatch of shipments across the Blue Dart network.
* Coordinate movement of shipments through scheduled air, surface and feeder networks to maintain network connectivity.
* Monitor loading, unloading, scanning, tallying and dispatch activities to ensure shipment accuracy.
* Coordinate vehicle placement and dock activities to minimise turnaround times.
* Ensure timely movement of priority, premium and time\-definite shipments across the network.

**Network Coordination \& Exception Management**

* Monitor adherence to network schedules and proactively manage delays, misconnections, misroutes and operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Network Operations and Regional Operations teams to resolve operational issues.
* Ensure timely communication of network disruptions and recovery actions to impacted stakeholders.
* Monitor stock lying at hub (SLAH) and drive timely clearance of pending shipments.
* Ensure accurate status updates and operational visibility across all network systems.

**Workforce \& Shift Leadership**

* Lead operational employees, supervisors and outsourced workforce during assigned shifts.
* Plan manpower deployment based on shipment volumes and operational priorities.
* Conduct daily shift briefings and communicate operational updates and safety requirements.
* Monitor workforce productivity, attendance and adherence to operational standards.
* Support capability building through coaching, training and performance feedback.

**Fleet, Capacity \& Resource Management**

* Ensure availability and optimum utilisation of vehicles, trailers and operational equipment to support scheduled network movements.
* Coordinate with fleet partners and transport vendors to minimise delays and maximise vehicle utilisation.
* Monitor dock utilisation, bay allocation and turnaround times to improve hub efficiency.
* Support capacity planning during peak volumes, network changes and seasonal demand fluctuations.
* Ensure operational readiness of manpower, equipment and infrastructure to meet business requirements.

**Service Quality \& Operational Excellence**

* Drive adherence to network timelines and ensure timely connectivity of shipments across the air or surface network.
* Monitor shipment accuracy, scanning compliance, loading quality and dispatch integrity to minimise operational errors.
* Ensure timely closure of operational exceptions, stock lying at hub (SLAH), misroutes and misconnections.
* Review operational performance trends and implement corrective actions to improve service reliability.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance hub productivity, service quality and operational efficiency.

**Safety, Security \& Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with organisational policies, operational SOPs, aviation or transportation regulations and statutory requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring safe handling of shipments, vehicles and operational equipment.
* Support periodic operational, security and quality audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory documentation, shipment security requirements and operational controls applicable to the hub.
* Identify operational risks and implement preventive measures to ensure uninterrupted hub operations.

**Stakeholder Management \& Operational Communication**

* Coordinate closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Operations, Customer Service, Security and Regional Operations teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Maintain effective communication with upstream and downstream network locations regarding shipment movements, operational disruptions and recovery plans.
* Ensure timely escalation of operational risks, capacity constraints and service issues to the Head – Hub Operations.
* Build collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and transport partners to improve network performance.
* Support implementation of organisational initiatives, process changes and operational improvement programmes across the hub.

**People Leadership \& Capability Development**

* Lead, coach and develop supervisors, operational employees and outsourced workforce to achieve operational objectives.
* Conduct regular shift briefings and ensure effective communication of operational priorities, safety requirements and service expectations.
* Monitor employee productivity, attendance, discipline and overall team performance.
* Support implementation of learning initiatives and on\-the\-job capability development programmes.
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, continuous improvement and customer focus across the hub.

**Education**:


* Bachelor's Degree in any discipline.
* Degree or certification in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management or Transportation Management will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* **Senior Executive – Hub Operations (Grade N):** 3–5 years of experience in hub operations, mid\-mile logistics, transportation or express distribution.
* **Assistant Manager – Hub Operations (Grade M):** 4 \- 7 years of relevant experience with demonstrated experience in leading medium to large hub operations.
* Experience in managing inbound, outbound and transit operations within an air or surface logistics network.
* Exposure to fleet coordination, shipment movement, operational planning and network performance management.
* Experience in leading frontline operational teams and working in high\-volume, time\-sensitive logistics environments.
